sources.title: Relativistic Radiation Magnetohydrodynamics in Dynamical Spacetimes: Numerical Methods and Tests
sources.authors: Brian D. Farris, Tsz Ka Li, Yuk Tung Liu, Stuart L. Shapiro
sources.read_scope: PDF text pp3-4, section II.B.1 equations19-33; geometrized units and metric at sectionII/A. Not a full-paper scientific audit.
equation_observations: Equation19: radiation divergence = minus G, where G is matter four-force.
Equation30: G^alpha = integral dnu dOmega (chi_nu I_nu - eta_nu) N^alpha.
Equations31-33 add isotropic coherent scattering, Kirchhoff and grey assumptions; not imported into non-LTE CaseA.
Equation26 uses the paper Eddington closure P=E/3 without general anisotropic pi; not used as the Bianchi anisotropic tensor closure.

sources.title: Anisotropic stresses in inhomogeneous universes
sources.read_scope: SectionII decomposition and kinematics equations1,4,5; exact radiation energy/momentum equations11,12 and nearby statement of nonlinear scope. PDF pp2-3 (energy equation p3).
equation_observations: Equation11: dot(mu)+(4/3)Theta mu+D^a q_a = -sigma^ab pi_ab -2A^a q_a.
Equation12 retains acceleration, spatial pressure/stress gradient, expansion, shear and vorticity in radiation momentum.
Original two fluids are non-interacting. Collision/source projection for the current H/He model must come from its own common four-force, not from this source-free equation by citation alone.

sources.title: A scheme for radiation pressure and photon diffusion with the M1 closure in RAMSES-RT
sources.read_scope: Section2.3.3 PDFp5 equations26-28; section2.1 unit/frame definitions; AppendixA PDFp24 for explicit O(v/c) scope and observed signs. HTML27-28 coincide with PDF; HTML91-99 correspond to PDFA1-A9.
equation_observations: Equation27 adds H/He opacity to momentum source: sum_i (F_i/c)(kappa_i rho+sum_j sigma_ij n_j), with energy flux F_i.
Equation28 accumulates momentum across thermochemistry substeps; gas kinetic energy is updated afterward.
AppendixA explicitly truncates at first order v/c, neglecting squared terms.

PDF text A7 appears to have a plus absorption-flux term at v=0 while A3 has minus; A6 and A8 show same-signed force-work terms. These particular mixed-frame sign equations are excluded from the adopted exact-covariant basis.

sources.title: RAMSES-RT: Radiation hydrodynamics in the cosmological context
sources.authors: J. Rosdahl, J. Blaizot, D. Aubert, T. Stranex, R. Teyssier
sources.read_scope: AppendixA PDFp37 equationsA6-A10 and p38 A15-A16; matching HTML54-58 and63-64. Selected main thermochemistry context.
equation_observations: Spherically symmetric recombination supplies photon numbers without a corresponding emitted photon flux source in the selected rest-frame description.
Photoheating A15 uses photon energy minus ionization energy; A16 preserves separate number/energy-weighted cross sections.
Its recombination radiation/OTS choice is not the current CaseA escape closure; only isotropic angular moment and heating bookkeeping roles are reused.
The inspected equations do not supply species-resolved recoil or captured-moment calibration for the current atomic provider.

source_issues.observation: HTML97/98 and PDF text A7/A8 show signs inconsistent with neighboring absorption and total-energy statements under the ordinary shared-opacity v=0 comparison.
source_issues.disposition: Do not import those particular mixed-frame equations into candidate. Use L01 general covariant force and only explicit first-order approximation scope from this appendix. No candidate criterion or physics assumption changed.
